messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — ACME sent an escalation: invoice INV-2026-0815 (USD 28,450) is on hold. Finance says PO required and VAT registration number mismatch. Customer is asking for Net 60 terms while their card declined last week. (cc @lisa_finance @priya_ae)
priya_ae: They're asking for Net 60 to align with their procurement cycle. They've been on hosted since Apr and current monthly spend ~12k. High product usage, wants no downtime. Will try to get PO & VAT docs today.
billing-bot: Payment failed: card_declined (code 101) for INV-2026-0815 on 2026-08-14 11:02 UTC. Auto-retry: 2 attempts remaining.
lisa_finance: Thanks — need a copy of the PO (scanned PDF or PO#) + VAT registration certificate that matches billing address. We also need signed net-terms addendum for Net 60. Given the declined card, we can't grant long-term Net 60 until KYC and a risk review.
sam_support: Suggested next steps for AE: ask customer to upload PO and VAT cert to the secure portal or attach to this thread. Template: "Hi — we can review Net 60 once we receive PO# + VAT cert and a signed Net Terms addendum. As a stopgap we can enable provisional access for 30 days if you provide PO by EOD and sign the addendum." Want me to send from support or do you want to?
matt_engineer: FYI — there is a UX gap: when invoices are created by AR ingestion the billing portal UI doesn't render the "attach PO" field. Workaround: attach file to support ticket and put PO number in metadata key `po_number` so AR mapping picks it up. I'll create a short runbook snippet we can paste.
priya_ae: I'll get PO and VAT cert from procurement now and push them into the portal. If support can enable provisional access, that buys me time to get the signed addendum.
lisa_finance: I can approve provisional access for 30 days, capped at $35k exposure, conditional on: (1) signed Net Terms addendum uploaded within 48h, (2) VAT proof that validates against EU VIES (or country equivalent), (3) PO number attached to the invoice metadata. If any condition fails, we'll suspend access and require upfront payment.
sam_support: Done — I created a provisional_credit record and flagged the account. Actioned: provisional access enabled, exposure limit $35k, expiry 2026-09-15. Note added to account: "pending Net Terms addendum + VAT verification" :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Admin action: provisional_credit +USD 35,000 applied to acct ACME_CORP by lisa_finance at 2026-08-15T15:32:04Z.
priya_ae: Quick q — can Finance change payment terms retroactively on the outstanding invoice once PO is provided? Customer expects invoice to say "Net 60" now.
lisa_finance: We can't change terms on a posted invoice retroactively without reissue. Options: (A) reissue invoice with Net 60 once PO & addendum received, (B) issue a short-term credit to cover immediate risk and set future invoices to Net 60 after approval. I recommend B + reissue for bookkeeping only if they need the invoice text changed.
sam_support: I'll add a sticky note to the invoice: "Reissue requested pending PO + addendum" and escalate to AR for reissue if finance requests.
matt_engineer: Runbook snippet (paste into reply if needed): ```1) Attach PO PDF to ticket 2) add metadata key po_number: <PO#> 3) Support triggers AR mapping job: /jobs/ingest_ar 4) Finance verifies VAT via VIES and marks ticket resolved```
priya_ae: I'll upload PO+VAT now and send signed addendum later today. Thanks team — will update thread once uploaded.
sam_support: Great — monitoring. If the upload doesn't show in the portal, ping me and I'll map manually.
